page_note: Page has clear tripartite structure. Unit 1 (0-6): cosmological substrate on Love as bond of Greatness, the Father/Master of All, with his Aeons and members. Unit 2 (7-19): editorial ecclesial extension applying the 'Love' identification to the Holy Church — the classic 'now moreover X also exists in the church' editorial seam. Includes a Johannine citation (John 15:13, 'no greater love...') marked by 'as it is written.' Unit 3 (20-34): substratic teaching on Hatred as the first death from the land of Darkness, with the cosmic derivation chain Hatred→Envy→Devil→Wicked One. The seam flag at i=20 catches the dialogue formula 'Once again he said' but the substantive cosmological question/answer that follows is core. Editorial fatigue score is misleading here — the negative shift reflects ecclesial concentration in the FIRST half (the church-extension), with substrate returning in the second half. Heavy lacunae (71.4%) limit certainty.
